newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China to release 10,000 pigeons to mark HK handover.
newsitem.headline: China to release 10,000 pigeons to mark HK handover.

text.p: Hong Kong's skies will be filled with pigeons on the day that China takes over the British colony. A community group plans to release 10,000 homing pigeons from 30 mainland China cities to celebrate China's takeover.
The Heung Yee Kuk community group has asked the Royal Racing Pigeon Association to help take care of the pigeons during their short stay in Hong Kong, the South China Morning Post said.
The pigeons will arrive by train in late June, several days before their mass takeoff from Sha Tin in Hong Kong's rural New Territories region on the handover day.

The group said the pigeons would carry the handover message to Chinese all over the country. Some of the feathered couriers will be from as far away as the Chinese capital Beijing, 2,500 km (1,600 miles) to the north, it said.
